description: Issue #178 (a): a declared open question rides the EXISTING gate, so nothing new had to be taught to the dispatch runner. #460's body carries one ```open-questions block; the plan therefore carries one question, and by default dispatch refuses the WHOLE plan before the first `send`. #461 would have succeeded (the scenario has both workers completing with verify 0) — the refusal comes from the plan, not from the world. The blocking reason quotes the author's own sentence, which is what lets the operator answer it without opening the issue.
